cases.name: finds each start by the narrator's words, copied from the transcript
cases.prompt:
I transcribed demo.mov with voiceover_transcribe. segments.txt says:
[0.00–3.10] um so okay this is the the dashboard
[3.10–6.00] and here you can see the alerts we raise
[6.00–9.40] uh each one links to the transaction
Write the voice-over script for it, one line per sentence.

args_match.lines: starts_with:(um )?(so )?(okay )?this is the.*starts_with:and here you can.*starts_with:(uh )?each one links

cases.name: places the lines of a video with no narration by time
cases.prompt: promo.mp4 has no narration. voiceover_frames showed the logo at 0 s, the dashboard at 6 s and the pricing page at 14 s. Write a three-line voice-over script that introduces each as it appears.
